items.source: In order for Hibernate's default validation messages to be resolved still, your MessageSource must be configured for optional resolution (usually the default). In particular, the MessageSource instance specified here should not apply "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" behavior. Please double-check your setup accordingly.
items.translation: 为了使 Hibernate 的默认验证消息仍然能够解析，您的 MessageSource 必须配置为可选解析（通常是默认设置）。特别是，此处指定的 MessageSource 实例不应应用 "useCodeAsDefaultMessage" 行为。请相应地仔细检查您的配置。

items.source: Specify either this property or "messageInterpolator", not both. If you would like to build a custom MessageInterpolator, consider deriving from Hibernate Validator's ResourceBundleMessageInterpolator and passing in a Spring-based ResourceBundleLocator when constructing your interpolator.
items.translation: 指定此属性或"messageInterpolator"其中之一，不可同时指定两者。如果您希望构建自定义的 MessageInterpolator，请考虑继承 Hibernate Validator 的ResourceBundleMessageInterpolator，并在构造插值器时传入基于 Spring 的ResourceBundleLocator。

items.source: When talking to an instance of this bean through the Spring or JSR-303 Validator interfaces, you'll be talking to the default Validator of the underlying ValidatorFactory. This is very convenient in that you don't have to perform yet another call on the factory, assuming that you will almost always use the default Validator anyway. This can also be injected directly into any target dependency of type Validator!
items.translation: 通过 Spring 或 JSR-303 Validator 接口与该 Bean 的实例进行交互时，您实际上是在与底层 ValidatorFactory 的默认 Validator 进行交互。这非常方便，因为您无需再对工厂执行另一次调用（假设您几乎总是使用默认 Validator）。此外，还可以直接将此对象注入到任何类型为 Validator 的目标依赖项中！

items.source: NOTE: This feature requires Hibernate Validator 4.3 or higher on the classpath. You may nevertheless use a different validation provider but Hibernate Validator's ResourceBundleMessageInterpolator class must be accessible during configuration.
items.translation: 注意：此功能需要在类路径中包含 Hibernate Validator 4.3 或更高版本。尽管如此，您仍可使用不同的验证提供者，但必须在配置期间可访问 Hibernate Validator 的ResourceBundleMessageInterpolator类。

items.source: Default is a SpringConstraintValidatorFactory, delegating to the containing ApplicationContext for creating autowired ConstraintValidator instances.
items.translation: 默认值为一个SpringConstraintValidatorFactory，委托给包含的 ApplicationContext 来创建自动注入的 ConstraintValidator 实例。

items.source: Default is Hibernate Validator's own internal use of standard Java reflection. This may be overridden with a custom subclass or a Spring-controlled DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer if necessary.
items.translation: 默认值为 Hibernate Validator 自身对标准 Java 反射的内部使用。如有必要，可使用自定义子类或受 Spring 控制的DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer进行覆盖。

items.source: This enables convenient customizations for application purposes. Infrastructure extensions may keep overriding the postProcessConfiguration(Configuration) template method.
items.translation: 这为应用程序用途提供了便捷的自定义功能。基础设施扩展可能会不断重写postProcessConfiguration(Configuration)模板方法。

items.source: This class is also being used by Spring's MVC configuration namespace, in case of the jakarta.validation API being present but no explicit Validator having been configured.
items.translation: 该类也被 Spring 的 MVC 配置命名空间使用，在存在 `jakarta.validation` API 但未显式配置验证器的情况下。
